subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized his mending skills were in high demand after the boat sank.
source_quote: The boat is sunk. My mending skills are in high demand.

subject: Grygum's desire to avoid ships
fact: Grygum wants to avoid ending up on a ship, but the reason for this desire is kept secret from himself.
source_quote: And if I want to not end up on a ship, it's best to keep it secret from myself.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized the adventure was not about escape, but about learning and exploration.
source_quote: But now that we have been wandering through the world, I realize it’s an opportunity to learn and explore.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was a Drow of Menzoberranzan, trapped in ritual and expectations.
source_quote: My whole life, I was a Drow of Menzoberranzan. Trapped in the formalities of ritual and expectations.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized the Underdark not as a place to flee, but as a place to explore and learn.
source_quote: I never saw the Underdark for what it is, a place to explore and learn.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz understood this journey as an escape from a previous worldview, not to another place.
source_quote: And now I know this journey not as an escape to another place, but instead as an escape from a previous worldview.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz values discovery, appreciating the diversity of ecosystems, life forms, and civilizations.
source_quote: My journey is about discovery, appreciating the diversity of ecosystems, life forms, and civilizations, and learning.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth hid our tracks for two days, during which all they could see were the dark passages.
source_quote: For two days, Eldeth has been hiding our tracks for two days, where all we could see when we could see was the dark passages.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith insisted he knew where they were going.
source_quote: Sarith insisted he knew where we were going.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was hoping to see new things.
source_quote: I was hoping to see new things.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the air grow thick with the familiar, subtle hum of the Faerzress.
source_quote: We turned down yet another passageway, and the air grew thick with a familiar, subtle hum, the Faerzress.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed the wall suffused with the arcane glowing magic of the Faerzress.
source_quote: Ahead, there was no longer the rough-hewn stone, but an area suffused with the arcane glowing magic of the Faerzress.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupting from the wall, shedding dim ten-foot radiance.
source_quote: Fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupted from the wall, shedding a dim ten-foot radiance.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wanted to experience and explore the crystals, no longer seeing them as obstacles.
source_quote: Before, this would have been yet another obstacle, another exotic backdrop to our desperate flight to safety, but now I wanted to experience and explore.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suggested collecting crystals and looking around.
source_quote: “Let’s collect some of these crystals and look around.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz saw two desperate humans in a corner and surmised they were escapees from the Drow.
source_quote: In a corner were two desperate humans. I stare at them and quickly surmise they are escapees from the Drow.

subject: Male human
fact: The male human shouted, “Who are you? And back off!” while holding a crystal as a weapon.
source_quote: “Who are you? And back off!” shouts a male human. He holds a crystal as a weapon.

subject: Male human
fact: The male human is named Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper to his friends, and was a farmer.
source_quote: His name is Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper to his friends, who had lost his sister and went looking for her in the Underdark. He explains that he is just a farmer.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wondered if Fuurm had skills as a rogue, fighter, wizard, or cleric.
source_quote: I look at him and wonder if he has any skills as a rogue, a fighter, a wizard, or a cleric, but he explains that he is just a farmer.

subject: Baedora
fact: Baedora explained that demons attacked, the Drow fought back, and they ran to survive.
source_quote: “That it was demons that attacked. The Drow fought back. We ran. Figured we were more likely to stay alive away from Drow and Demons.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz invited Fuurm and Baedora to join the group.
source_quote: And so I invite them to join our group.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz and the group smashed the cavern and crystals to hide their tracks as if a monster had attacked.
source_quote: To hide our tracks, we smash the cavern and the crystals, as if some monster had attacked, not escaped slaves who took crystals that shone in the darkness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the air grow heavy with the subtle, earthy scent of damp loam and something indescribably sweeter.
source_quote: the air grew heavy with the subtle, earthy scent of the damp loam and something indescribably sweeter.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observed towering stalks and caps of fungi, a veritable forest of the subterranean, some glowing faintly with bioluminescent light.
source_quote: There were the towering stalks and caps of fungi, a veritable forest of the subterranean. Mushrooms of all kinds and of all types, stretching up into the unseen ceiling, some glowing faintly with a soft, bioluminescent light, others a muted, earthy brown.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that Stool was curled up contentedly against Thorin's back, reliving his idea to ride the dwarf.
source_quote: Stool, my new myconid friend, was curled up contentedly against Thorin's back, probably still reliving his 'good idea' to ride on the dwarf.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard a sudden, piercing shriek that ripped through the air and vibrated through the rock — shriekers.
source_quote: Then, it hit. A sudden, piercing shriek that ripped through the heavy air and vibrated through the very rock beneath my feet. Not one, but many. Shriekers.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought he might have to survive throwing a crystal at the shrieker.
source_quote: I even thought, "I was gonna have to survive throwing a crystal at the shrieker".

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum threw a crystal that clattered against a fungal cap, but the shrieking did not change.
source_quote: The crystal sailed through the air, a small, glowing arc, and clattered against a broad fungal cap. And the shrieking... didn't change.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded the fungi were not actively harmful, just loud alarms for bigger threats.
source_quote: Still, at least it meant the fungi weren't actively harmful themselves, just loud alarms for bigger, hungrier things.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth was worried that messing with the environment made it easier for the Drow to track them.
source_quote: Eldeth is worried; she’s reasonably convinced we have thrown the Drow off our tracks, but every time we mess with the environment, we make it easier for them.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum told Eldeth not to worry.
source_quote: I tell her not to worry.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar shouted, “Want to make a bet?”
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, “Want to make a bet?”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked Jimjar to bet that the crystals would be useful.
source_quote: I turn to him, “Wanna bet that these crystals will be useful?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar smiled and agreed to the bet, though he was confused by others making bets.
source_quote: He looks at me, confused. He’s not used to other people making the bet. But he smiles and says, “Yes, I do.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt his dragonborn scales rough against his skin, reminded of the grime and chill.
source_quote: My dragonborn scales feel rough against my skin, constantly reminded of the grime and the chill that permeates everything.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir heard a soft, feminine voice in his mind pleading for help, pinpointing the tomb entrance.
source_quote: Then, it happens. A soft, feminine voice, distant yet clear, rings out in my mind, "Hello? Is someone there? Oh, please, I need your help! I have been trapped in the dark for so long... so very long. Please, won't you help me? Won't your help to free me?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked if the voice's direction matched their intended path to the tomb.
source_quote: I ask, my voice a low rumble, ever the pragmatist, seeking confirmation that this isn't some new diversion. "Is that the direction we were going anyway?"

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith nodded that the voice's direction was indeed the way they intended to go.
source_quote: Sarith nods yes, this is the way. Of course, it does.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observed the ancient stone double door of the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: We arrive at a large double door. The stone is ancient, hinting at a lost era, a common theme in this alien landscape.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw a stone diorama depicting Brysis of Khaem surrounded by her retinue.
source_quote: To the right, a stone diorama stands, depicting a Netherese noble, Brysis of Khaem, surrounded by her retinue, flaunting wealth and power.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw a sprawling mural illustrating fantastic floating cities.
source_quote: To the left, a sprawling mural covers the wall, illustrating fantastic floating cities.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knows the lore of Netheril, a civilization whose cities defied gravity before collapsing due to hubris.
source_quote: I know the lore of the Netheril Empire – a civilization of immensely powerful magic users, whose cities defied gravity, only to fall catastrophically when one of their leaders tried to seize all magical power, tearing the very fabric of reality.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s monastic training emphasizes balance and inner peace, not the pursuit of absolute external power.
source_quote: My monastic training emphasizes balance and inner peace, not the dangerous pursuit of absolute external power.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wondered what kind of sorceress Brysis was to be buried here.
source_quote: It makes me wonder what kind of sorceress Brysis was to be buried here.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took the lead down the dusty staircase, carefully testing each step.
source_quote: We descend a dusty staircase. Grygum, with his keen perception, takes the lead, carefully testing each step.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted a Netherese Calendar Stone on one landing.
source_quote: On one landing, I note a Netherese Calendar Stone, a relic of a time long gone, its purpose unclear.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir spoke, "Proof here of a lower power," and immediately recognized the absurdity of the conclusion.
source_quote: I focus, drawing on my monk's discipline, seeking patterns, anomalies in the dust, and then I speak, "Proof here of a lower power." What an absurd conclusion that immediately grates on my own rational mind.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted recent damage but no tracks in the thick layer of dust.
source_quote: Grygum, thankfully, is more successful. He notes recent damage but no tracks in the thick layer of dust.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled old tales of floating undead creatures that rest in tombs.
source_quote: He then recalls old tales of “floating undead creatures that typically rest in tombs”.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembered Fargas Rumblefoot's warning about a secret room or false tomb.
source_quote: I remember Fargas Rumblefoot's warning about a "secret room" or "false tomb" here, adding another layer of treachery to this place.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz checked an altar and found nothing of arcane significance.
source_quote: Daz checks an altar, finding nothing of arcane significance, another dead end for now.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the northeast sarcophagus rested on hidden stone rollers.
source_quote: And then, Grygum points it out: the northeast sarcophagus rests on hidden stone rollers. A possible secret, a hidden passage.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir moved into position and called forth shadows, plunging the area into magical darkness.
source_quote: I move into position, my hands forming the familiar gestures. I call forth the shadows, plunging the area around the sarcophagus into a sphere of magical darkness.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin leveraged the darkness to push the heavy sarcophagus aside, revealing a hole.
source_quote: Thorin, strong as an ox, leverages the darkness, pushing the heavy sarcophagus aside. The stone grinds, revealing... a hole.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt a chill emanate from everywhere at once, and rime crept across surfaces.
source_quote: A chill emanates from everywhere at once. Rime creeps across surfaces, and my breath plumes before me in the suddenly frigid air.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw a figure detach itself from the shadows and glide toward him — weightless, formless, undead.
source_quote: I see a figure detach itself from the shadows and glide toward me—weightless, formless, undead.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed four Spectres hovering, incorporeal and menacing.
source_quote: Four Spectres now hover, incorporeal and menacing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz heard the same soft, feminine voice from before, pleading in his mind.
source_quote: "No, you must save me!" a soft, feminine voice cries out in my mind. It's the same voice from when we entered the tomb, trapped, pleading.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast Magic Missile, striking two Spectres with three bolts.
source_quote: With a familiar incantation, I conjure the shimmering darts of pure force. Magic Missile. Two bolts streak through the darkness, finding their mark on one Spectre. Another bolt follows, striking a second Spectre.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz felt necrotic damage as one Spectre’s icy touch drained his life force.
source_quote: One Spectre lunges at me, its chilling form passing through my defenses. A jolt of cold, raw energy courses through me, necrotic damage, and I feel my very life force diminish.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz felt twice as much necrotic damage from a second Spectre's attack.
source_quote: Before I can fully process it, another Spectre attacks, a more potent drain this time, twice as much necrotic damage, and my strength wanes further.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz muttered, "I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon," a desperate plea for recovery.
source_quote: "I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon," I mutter, the words barely audible, a desperate plea for recovery.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tried to turn the Spectres with his holy symbol, but they resisted.
source_quote: Grygum, in his devotion, tries to turn them, his holy symbol raised, but the Spectres resist, their wills too strong, or perhaps their existence too ancient to be swayed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir moved his sphere of darkness and punched and pummeled the Spectres, killing two.
source_quote: Zalthir, ever the whirlwind, moves his sphere of darkness, then his fists become blurs in the gloom, punching and pummeling. He kills one, then another.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir declared, "I will punch the ghost!"
source_quote: "I will punch the ghost!" he declares.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz inquired, "Is this, would this be a good time for us to take a… Long rest. By chance?"
source_quote: "Is this, would this be a good time for us to take a… Long rest. By chance?" I inquire, hopefully.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembered that many undead creatures return after being destroyed if the central evil force remains.
source_quote: I remember that many such creatures will return after being destroyed when the central evil force that created them remains.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knew that if they rested, the Spectres would return, and might pursue them.
source_quote: If we rest, we will find them here when we come back. And although they may just stay here, they may also pursue us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz opened the sarcophagi and found mummified remains, tattered burial garments, and Netherese treasure.
source_quote: We open the sarcophagi. Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the gilded sarcophagus gleamed against one wall, and a subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.
source_quote: A gilded sarcophagus gleams against one wall, clearly the focal point, and I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt a cold, empty feeling of undeath as a Wraith rose from the sarcophagus.
source_quote: Then, a cold, empty feeling washes over me, a familiar touch of undeath. From the sarcophagus, a figure rises, ethereal and malicious. A Wraith.

subject: Wraith
fact: The Wraith declared, "Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!"
source_quote: Its voice, resonant with ancient menace, fills our minds, not with the pleas of the previous Spectres, but with a chilling declaration: "Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers that a Wraith, when it kills, turns its victims into Specters.
source_quote: I remember that a wraith, when it kills, turns its victims into specters, and I shudder.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembered that they are resistant to fire.
source_quote: Daz contemplates a Fireball, but then remembers that they are resistant to fire.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz decided to use magic missiles.
source_quote: Magic missiles it is,

subject: Wraith
fact: Wraith glided forward, a silent, menacing presence.
source_quote: The wraith glides forward, a silent, menacing presence,

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was protected by his armor and the grace of Bahamut.
source_quote: the dwarf's armor and the grace of Bahamut protect him;

subject: Wraith
fact: Wraith hovered back into its sarcophagus.
source_quote: the Wraith hovers back into its sarcophagus.

subject: Narrator
fact: Narrator thought, 'Coward,' with dry amusement stirring within.
source_quote: "Coward," I think, a dry amusement stirring within me.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir cast his magical darkness, spreading it to cover the entire room.
source_quote: Zalthir moves. Ever the tactician, he casts his magical darkness, spreading it to cover the entire room.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir moved the sarcophagus.
source_quote: I hear him move, and then move the sarcophagus.

subject: Feminine Voice
fact: Feminine voice spoke, 'In the sarcophagus! I can help you!'
source_quote: the soft, feminine voice from earlier, the one that first called to us, speaks again, "In the sarcophagus! I can help you!"

subject: Trapped Entity
fact: The trapped entity, the true owner of the voice, is inside this sarcophagus, but its identity is not specified in this session.
source_quote: So, the trapped entity, the true owner of the voice, is inside this sarcophagus.

subject: Wraith's Identity
fact: It is unknown whether the entity is the Wraith or something else.
source_quote: Is it the Wraith or is it something else?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir looked in.
source_quote: Zalthir looks in.
